description: This file defines the UserGroup class within the OpenCart admin module. It provides methods to manage user group records in the database, including adding, editing, deleting, retrieving, and manipulating permissions.

classes.name: UserGroup
classes.description: A class for managing user group data within the OpenCart admin module, providing CRUD operations and permission management.

methods.name: addUserGroup
methods.description: Creates a new user group record in the database using provided data.

methods.name: editUserGroup
methods.description: Updates an existing user group record identified by ID with new data.

methods.name: deleteUserGroup
methods.description: Deletes a user group record from the database based on the provided ID.

methods.name: getUserGroup
methods.description: Retrieves user group information for a specific ID, decoding permissions from JSON.

methods.name: getUserGroups
methods.description: Fetches a list of user groups with optional sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalUserGroups
methods.description: Returns the total count of user groups in the database.

methods.name: addPermission
methods.description: Adds a permission route to a specified user group's permissions.

methods.name: removePermission
methods.description: Removes a specific permission route from a user group's permissions.
